question: Why do text-default emoji followed by U+FE0F (for example U+2764 U+FE0F) draw as black symbols in Chrome 128 but as colour emoji in Chrome 135, with the same fonts and a stack that lists DejaVu Sans before Noto Color Emoji?
method: 12 test sequences, CDP platform fonts for each node (colour = only Noto Color Emoji used); Chrome releases 113 to 155, then Chromium snapshot bisect between main positions 1356013 (130.0.6723) and 1368529 (131.0.6778)

commit_in_window.title: Move FontVariantEmoji and FontVariationSequences to stable
commit_in_window.mechanism: From the build that ships this feature, an emoji variation selector (U+FE0F) makes the browser pick a font that has an emoji presentation of the character; before it, the first font in the stack with the glyph won and drew a black symbol.
commit_in_window.caveat: The window is six commits. This is the only one that concerns emoji or variation sequences. We did not rebuild Chromium with and without it.

affected_items: 84 of 207 fully-qualified text-default emoji presentation sequences in the replay stack (Chrome 128: 84 split, 123 colour; Chrome 135: all 207 colour)
